summary: Retinol and glycolic acid can irritate skin, especially sensitive skin.
policy: Removing the acid or alternating nights is our conservative product policy, not a clinically validated universal incompatibility.

summary: Benzoyl peroxide may interact with tretinoin; consult the prescribing clinician.
policy: Flag only tretinoin, not every retinoid. Do not replace prescription instructions.

summary: For people with rosacea, fragrance and glycolic/lactic acids can irritate skin.
policy: Cautious extrapolation to a low redness score; a redness score does not diagnose rosacea.

summary: Moisturizer texture should suit skin type; creams are richer than gels.
policy: Lightweight preference for low oiliness score, rich cream for low moisture score. Not a claim that petrolatum causes acne.

summary: Avoid irritating alcohol/fragrance products when skin is dry.
policy: High denatured alcohol only; fatty alcohols are not included.

summary: AHAs may increase sun sensitivity; sunscreen and sun protection are advised.
policy: Remind about sunscreen without adding a purchase automatically.
